caption: The drawing depicts three views of a single ornate spoon, displayed within a rectangular border. The top view shows the front of the spoon, which has a shell-shaped bowl and a handle adorned with intricate scrolling and decorative motifs; there is some text engraved along the handle. The middle view presents the same spoon from the side, revealing a curved handle and the depth of the bowl, which is grooved, echoing the ridges of a shell. The bottom view illustrates the back of the spoon, again displaying the shell-shaped bowl and the decorated handle, which bears a monogram or initials. The drawings are rendered in grayscale with precise shading to suggest metallic texture, and the background is an off-white or aged paper with visible discoloration and stains, particularly at the top right and bottom right corners.
title: Two Silver Sugar Spoons
